lesson: [mimo2.6_distill_9b] To get passing MLP clusters of 64-512 units, take attribution seeds (top selective units in one layer) and grow them by the down_proj logit-lens z-score on the skill's tokens. L26 roman with seeds 4058/6190 dropped .536 at 64, .571 at 256 and .548 at 512, with random parts at most .03. L23 ordinal with seed 3497 dropped .35-.36 at 64/128/256. Writer clusters ranked by z alone, without seeds, were inert: month L25 -.07, country L30 -.004, colour L28 .049.

[mimo2.6_distill_9b] In early layers (L8-14), rank units by input side, not output: the silu(gate)*up response to the skill tokens' embeddings (post-attention RMSNorm applied), minus a random-token baseline, plus 1-3 attribution seeds. This gave passing greek detectors at L8 (.261), L9 (.232-.236), L12 (.287) and L13 (.228-.236), and roman at L8 (.16). The seeds themselves had about zero embedding z, so they encode context while the expansion units are token detectors.

[mimo2.6_distill_9b] Head groups: rank heads by how much of the skill's token energy lies in their out_proj columns (through final norm and lm_head) relative to random tokens. L28 linear-attention h25 (5.6x on ordinal tokens) dropped ordinal .723 alone, .735 as 4 heads. But 3 of 5 random 6-head groups (presumably the ones containing h25) also dropped it by about .72, so check whether one head carries the whole effect. In full-attention layers the engine uses 16 heads of 256 dims, not 32 of 128. Indexing them as 128-dim slices gives errors or the wrong heads.

[mimo2.6_distill_9b] Broad built-in skills could not be dented. Math, code and multilingual moved at most about .06 under any sub-layer part, including 512-unit code-writer clusters. Single-layer blocks hit facts by .2-.49 together with every narrow skill, so none were selective. A new en_fr_translation skill (base .91, 13-nat margin) was equally robust. Skills with a low base score and a narrow token class are where selective parts exist.

[mimo2.6_distill_9b] Shared sequence-successor units block single-skill screens. L19 heads [1,9,11,13] dropped month .584, ordinal .439, greek .338 and weekday .226 together. L24 unit 6064 and L16 unit 1951 drive month and greek. Removing the shared seed can flip a fail into a pass: L16 greek went from .521 with a month spill of .175 to a cleaner .226, though ordinal still leaked .131. Excluding the top-150 writers of the neighbouring category rarely helped.

[mimo2.6_distill_9b] Scan handles (scanN:SKILL:K) return only the 4-13 positively selective units, whatever K you ask for. Read the seeds from the scan, then build the 64+ cluster yourself in the sandbox. Also, the skill-define cap is 8, so plan new broad skills before spending slots.

[mimo2.6_distill_9b] Country-writer MLP clusters were inert. Ranking down_proj columns by country unembedding-subspace fraction, minus 1.5x the other categories, gave clean logit lenses (China/Egypt/Japan units, subspace fraction .041 vs .0019 random at L30). Yet 256-512 unit clusters at L24/L26/L30 dropped country_of_city by at most .031. The skill has a high base score (.77), so skip writer recipes for high-margin skills.

[mimo2.6_distill_9b] Attribution seed plus weight-cosine growth found the only near-pass. L14 u3335 (roman attribution .051) grown by summed gate/up/down cosine to 64/128/256 units cut roman_numeral by .124/.138/.108 with control at most .03, against random at most .024. It still failed: .138 is under the .15 bar and held-out failed. Next time use several seeds from the same layer to push the drop above .2.

[mimo2.6_distill_9b] L16 holds a shared successor hub rather than skill-specific units. 128-unit clusters seeded on colour or country attribution dropped greek .50/.23, month .20/.26 and ordinal .29/.24, but not their own seed skills (colour .05, country .00). The seed's skill label did not predict what the grown cluster does, so ablate before choosing a screen target.

[mimo2.6_distill_9b] Whole blocks were never selective. L20-21 dropped facts .45, general_text .21 and greek .31. Single L14 swung months and weekdays wildly (-.57/-.93) and moved the colour control by -1.14. Low-base skills (ordinal .047, weekday .058, greek .09, month .11) give noisy, sign-flipping drops, so rely on high-base skills (roman .65, colour .40, country .77) for target and leak checks.

[mimo2.6_distill_9b] Infra: py: handles are lowercased, so save /work JSON files with lowercase names. Sandbox functions do not persist between run_python calls, so redefine helpers each call. Scans unlock after 5 run_python calls plus 1 ablate. With a 0.2-hour limit I used only 1 of 35 screens, so screen earlier.
